description: Take the marketing app (the video-production pipeline: topic research/dedup, Thai script generation, scene editor, campaign/project persistence) from feature-complete to a deployed MVP. FR-1..FR-6 are met and 151 tests were green in video_pipeline_20260613 (archived). The vinext/vite parseSync build blocker that was deferred to repo-owner is now RESOLVED — `pnpm --filter marketing build` completes cleanly (dist/client + dist/server). This track verifies/pins the build, hard-gates on Wave 3 marketing security (the GET /api/settings decrypted-API-key leak and unauthenticated /api/video/* routes), adds a vinext-runtime Dockerfile + cloudbuild, provisions the DB, deploys to Cloud Run, and runs manual QA.
deviation_notes: Successor to the deferred build+deploy remainder of the archived video_pipeline_20260613 track (no live track owned it). Marketing security remediation is owned by Wave 3 (authz/zod/adapter) + Wave 5 (schema/UX/i18n) + Wave 6 (test backfill) per medium-plus-coverage-matrix.md — this track does not duplicate it, it consumes Wave 3 as a hard deploy precondition. Build blocker found already resolved on 2026-07-01 during evaluation; Phase 0 verifies and pins rather than fixes.
